name: TACT5-retreats-from-press
old: const open = (backTurned && dist <= ring + TACT.RING_SLACK) || dist < ring - TACT.RING_SLACK;
new: const open = backTurned && dist <= ring + TACT.RING_SLACK;

name: TACT5-recover-retreats
old: s.backUntil = now + TACT.RECOVER_HOP; // FEEDBACK: a hop out, not a retreat
new: s.backUntil = s.until; // FEEDBACK: a hop out, not a retreat

name: TACT5-backstep-unbounded
TACT5-kite-backpedals
TACT5-backoff-no-cooldown
TACT5-kite-no-cooldown
old:
s.kind =
    shooter(ai) && now >= s.meleeUntil && (dist >= TACT.KITE_IN || s.kiting || now >= (s.kiteReady ?? 0))
      ? 'ranged'
      : 'melee';
new: s.kind = shooter(ai) && now >= s.meleeUntil && (dist >= TACT.KITE_IN || s.kiting || true) ? 'ranged' : 'melee';

name: TACT5-token-kept-across-kinds
old:
if (s.kind === 'ranged') b.melee.delete(ai);
  else b.ranged.delete(ai); // FEEDBACK: a token of the kind it no longer fights as is handed back
new:
if (false) b.melee.delete(ai);
  else if (false) b.ranged.delete(ai); // FEEDBACK: a token of the kind it no longer fights as is handed back

name: TACT5-shooter-circles
old:
// (it holds its fire), never circling the target
    return false;
new:
// (it holds its fire), never circling the target
    return holdRing(ai, s, b, ux, uz, dist, ring + 2, now, face);

name: TACT5-walk-away-unheld
old: const away = s.key != null && (s.kiting || s.state === 'backoff' || now < (s.faceUntil ?? 0));

name: TACT5-blocked-walks-on
old: if (this._tacDir) { this._tacDir = null; this._tacBlocked = true; this.moving = false; }
